### Target Files
- `models.py`
- `bucket.py`
- `registry.py`
- `middleware.py`

### Symbols & Line Ranges
- `models.py`:
  - `as_decimal` (lines 6–15)
  - `BucketState.__post_init__` (lines 25–27)
- `bucket.py`:
  - `TokenBucket.__init__` (lines 8–10)
  - `TokenBucket.refill` (lines 12–20)
  - `TokenBucket.consume` (lines 22–30)
- `registry.py`:
  - `BucketRegistry.__init__` (lines 8–10)
  - `BucketRegistry.add` (lines 12–18)
  - `BucketRegistry.get` (lines 20–21)
- `middleware.py`:
  - `RateLimiter.consume` (lines 6–10)

### Invariants & Exact Changes
- **`models.py` — `as_decimal(value)`**:
  - Currently converts via `Decimal(str(float(value)))`, which loses precision on `Decimal`, `int`, and `str` inputs.
  - Reject `bool` with `ValueError`.
  - If `isinstance(value, Decimal)`, use `value` directly; otherwise convert `int`, `str`, or `float` via `Decimal(str(value))` (catching `InvalidOperation`, `TypeError`, `ValueError` and raising `ValueError`).
  - Reject non-finite (`not result.is_finite()`) or negative (`result < 0`) values with `ValueError`.
- **`models.py` — `BucketState.__post_init__`**:
  - Normalize all four fields (`capacity`, `refill_rate`, `tokens`, `updated_at`) via `as_decimal`.
  - Enforce `self.capacity <= 0` -> raise `ValueError("capacity must be positive")`.
  - Enforce `self.tokens > self.capacity` -> raise `ValueError("tokens cannot exceed capacity")`.
  - `updated_at` nonnegative and `refill_rate` >= 0 are already enforced by `as_decimal`.
- **`bucket.py` — `TokenBucket.__init__(self, capacity, refill_rate, clock=time.monotonic)`**:
  - Currently hardcodes `updated_at=0`. Must timestamp initial state with `self.clock()` (i.e. `BucketState(capacity, refill_rate, capacity, self.clock())`).
- **`bucket.py` — `TokenBucket.refill(self, now=None)`**:
  - Currently calls `time.monotonic()` instead of `self.clock()` when `now is None`. Use `self.clock() if now is None else now`, normalized with `as_decimal`.
  - Currently uses `float(...)` arithmetic. Use exact `Decimal` arithmetic: `elapsed = now - state.updated_at`; if `now > state.updated_at` (or `now >= state.updated_at`), set `state.tokens = min(state.capacity, state.tokens + elapsed * state.refill_rate)` and `state.updated_at = now`.
  - Ignore backward time (`now < state.updated_at`): do not modify `tokens` or lower `updated_at`.
- **`bucket.py` — `TokenBucket.consume(self, amount=1, now=None)`**:
  - Validate `amount = as_decimal(amount)` and `if amount <= 0: raise ValueError("amount must be positive")` before any `refill` or state mutation.
  - Call `self.refill(now)`.
  - If `self.state.tokens < amount`, return `False` without deducting tokens.
  - Otherwise deduct `self.state.tokens -= amount` and return `True`.
- **`registry.py` — `BucketRegistry.__init__(self, clock=time.monotonic)`**:
  - Remove mutable default `buckets={}` from signature; initialize `self._buckets = {}` per instance.
- **`registry.py` — `BucketRegistry.add(self, tenant_id, name, capacity, refill_rate)` & `get(self, tenant_id, name)`**:
  - Index by `(tenant_id, name)` instead of `name`.
  - `add`: if `(tenant_id, name)` already in `self._buckets`, raise `ValueError` without replacing; otherwise create `TokenBucket(capacity, refill_rate, self.clock)`, store under `(tenant_id, name)`, and return it.
  - `get`: return `self._buckets[(tenant_id, name)]` (raises `KeyError` if missing).
- **`middleware.py` — `RateLimiter.consume(self, tenant_id, requests)`**:
  - Materialize `requests` (supports any iterable, including generators).
  - If empty, return `True` immediately.
  - Before any mutation: validate every `amount` with `as_decimal(amount)` and ensure `amount > 0` (raising `ValueError` on invalid/non-positive), resolve every `bucket_name` via `self.registry.get(tenant_id, name)` (raising `KeyError` if missing), and aggregate repeated bucket names (summing `Decimal` amounts per bucket).
  - Sample `now = self.registry.clock()` once for the nonempty request.
  - Snapshot `(bucket.state.tokens, bucket.state.updated_at)` for all participating buckets before mutating.
  - Refill every participating bucket at `now` (`bucket.refill(now)`).
  - Check if every participating bucket has `bucket.state.tokens >= total_amount`.
  - On `False` or any exception: restore `(tokens, updated_at)` on all participating buckets to their exact pre-request snapshots, then return `False` (or re-raise).
  - On success: deduct `total_amount` from each participating bucket's `state.tokens` and return `True`.

### Verify Command
`pytest -q --tb=short`
